श्यै, i. 1, Ātm. † To go.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. श्यान, Thick, viscous, adhesive.
 II. शीन, Thick. congealed.
 --With the prep. आ आ, To dry up,
. A little dry (i. e. श्यान, with आ),

.
 --With प्रति प्रति, प्रतिशीन, Melted, fluid, oozing.
श्यैनंपाता, i. e. श्येन + म्-पत् + अ + अ, f. Hawking, hunting.
